Box-Pushing Workflow

Key parameters

All coordinates are in the mocap (world) frame, in metres: origin at the field centre, x toward the table, y to the left as seen from the start mark, z up; yaw 0 = +x, positive anticlockwise seen from above. The numbers are the nominal layout: the vehicle exactly on its start mark and the box exactly at its place.

These are the planner's own goals (Plan with the vehicle on its start mark at the 1.30 m takeoff hover and the box at its place). Steps 1–4 are computed from the box (Get), so they move with the box. The start mark, Land Start and Land are typed and shifted by Adjust. The Go To Start time depends on where the vehicle hovers when Plan is pressed. Total planned flight: about 77 s.

Workflow

Isaac snapshot taken before the 2026-10-21 move, when the table stood 0.60 m further forward (reference corner (1.20, 0.50)); the start-to-table distance is the same.

Start everything as in the runbook's Whole-body - T650-AM - L1-Adaptive-4D-Impedance section, with MOCAP uav_0 obj_0 and the flight stack [Box-Pushing] (raw mocap; the _fused stack refuses box pushing). Unless a step says otherwise, every button is on the arm GS's Box Pushing tab.

  1. Table and box placement.
    • Table: length along y, 1.20 m ahead of the start mark. Put the reference leg (red circle: front-left, seen from the start) with its outer corner at (0.60, 0.50) m in the mocap frame; the top is 0.80 m. Check both with a marker: the planner keeps the drone clear of the table at x 0.60–0.75, y −0.50–0.50, top 0.80.
    • Box: on the bare table (no mat: the push expects about 1.2 N of friction), centred across the table, its back (+y) face 0.10 m from the table's +y end, the fin along y. Its centre is at (0.675, 0.28) m. Mass 240 g for the first test (the box emptied; 500 g full), with the bracket (weigh it: within ±50 g).

  2. Box rigid body in Motive.
    • Place the box as above, square to the room (yaw ≈ 0), and create the rigid body obj_0 from its markers. Use an asymmetric marker layout: Get refuses a flipping pose.
    • Move the pivot to the box's centre: centred in x and y, 50 mm above the table top.
    • Axes: x across the fin (the jaws close along x), y along the fin and the box's long side, towards the table's +y end, z up.
    • If the pivot cannot sit at the box's centre, set EE Offset z = 0.233 − the pivot's height above the table top.
  3. Check the table with the box (Get).
    • Put the box near the table's +y end, square to the table and centred across it (about 5 mm over each edge: the box is 160 mm wide, the table 150 mm), and press Get. Then move it near the −y end the same way and press Get again.
    • x must read the same at both ends, about 0.675. 1 cm of difference over the 0.76 m between the two places is 0.75° of table rotation; more than about 2 cm: turn the table.
    • yaw close to 0 at both ends (within ±1°): the box sits square to the room as well as to the table. The push follows the box's yaw, so this is what keeps it along the table.
    • z − 0.050 is the table-top height (0.800 expected). The same at both ends means a level table; a different height must go into push_pull_table's last number.
    • Put the box back at its start place, centre (0.675, 0.28), square to the table. The Get in step 5 is the one the planner uses.
  4. Bench check of the grip (first flight; vehicle on the ground, disarmed).
    • Arm GS, Gripper column: OPEN. Hold the box so the fin sits between the pads, about 25 mm below the fin top, then CLOSE.
    • Opening (m) must settle between −0.010 and −0.005 (the 3 mm pick-and-drop fin closed to −0.0097). Wider than −0.005 means the pads are on something else: the tab would call it a wrong grip and not push.
    • Pull the box gently along the fin: the pads must hold it (the push needs about 1.2 N). Then OPEN.
  5. Box pose → Get.
    With the box back in place, press Get: the Box (obj_0) row fills with x, y, z, yaw (editable; press Enter to send). Get refuses a frozen or flipping pose, or a moving box: fix the rigid body and press again. Get again whenever the box is moved.

  6. Drone thrust test.
  7. Start → Adjust.
    Vehicle on its start mark, (−0.60, 0) m, facing along +x (yaw ≈ 0). Adjust shifts the Start, Land Start and Land rows by the measured offset; the box is measured, never shifted.
  8. Check the settings.
    Press a button only if you change its value.
    • EE Offset [0, 0, 0.183]. From the box centre (obj_0's origin) to where the claw grips the fin, in the box's frame: 25 mm below the fin top, 233 mm above the table.
    • Vertical Margin 0.15. How far above the grasp point the claw waits at Go To Start.
    • Side Margin 0.12. How far behind the grasp point the claw waits; Ready To Push slides it in from there.
    • Push Distance 0.10 for the first test (0.50 the full push). How far the box slides along the table (−y). The Monitor under the points shows the push time, the contact time and the mean speed this gives (amber until you press Push Distance): the time is the distance at the planner's mean speed, 21 mm/s (push_pull_push_mean_speed, the one setting, in the yaml), so 0.10 m takes 4.8 s and the jaws hold the box 6.3 s. The numbers are green inside the tested range (0.10–0.50 m, 8–30 mm/s) and red outside it, with a note saying what to retype.
  9. Take off.
    In SAFETY to 1.3 m from the drone GS and wait for a steady hover. (Not 1.0 m: from there Plan refuses Go To Start.)
  10. Switch to DIRECT.
    From the drone GS Controller tab. Wait until the tab's status reads NOT PLANNED: press Plan. Never switch to DIRECT on the ground with props on.
  11. Plan.
    This dry-runs all six steps and draws the path. Wait for READY next=go_to_start. If it says INFEASIBLE, read the reason before going on (a box-on-table refusal usually means obj_0's yaw is wrong).
    • The Monitor under the points, now against plan, top to bottom: Push Time, Contact Time (the 1.5 s hold + the push), Mean Speed, Box Speed, Box Travelled (the box from mocap obj_0) -- live during the push, then the push's numbers until the next push or Reset -- and last Table Offset: the landing gear's height above the table top, plan the lowest anywhere the plan takes it over the table (about 0.12 m at the grasp), now the live value; green ≥ 0.05 m (what the planner keeps), amber below, red under the top, grey while the gear is not over the table.
    • Right of the Monitor rows, the Mocap lamp (the raw-mocap guard on the Orin): green MOCAP is the only state to fly in. EKF2 BRIDGE (amber) means the drone's mocap paused, froze or jumped and the odometry is EKF2's for the moment; with the claw on the box a fault longer than 0.15 s aborts the push by itself (jaws open, climb, arm home) and every step waits. LOST -- LAND WITH THE RC (red, flashing, beeping): take over in STAB within about 2 s and land -- EKF2 alone drifts tens of centimetres in a few seconds. NO LINK: the Orin's guard status stopped arriving.
  12. 1 Go To Start.
    The drone flies to the table's left (+y) end and turns right to −90°; the claw stops one Side Margin behind and one Vertical Margin above the grasp point. Wait for DONE go_to_start.
  13. 2 Ready To Push.
    The gripper opens; once it reports open, the claw slides down-forward onto the fin. Wait for DONE ready.
  14. 3 Push (press once).
    The gripper closes once the claw is within 2 cm of the grasp point and centred across the fin to 3 mm. Once it grips (on hardware: the close completes, no wider than −0.005 m) the push starts by itself: the contact line turns purple, the drone holds 1.5 s, then slides the box the Push Distance at 21 mm/s (0.10 m: 4.8 s); the Monitor shows the box's travel and speed against the plan. If the lamp says wrong grip, nothing in the jaws or no result, nothing moves: press 4 Exit To Push (or ABORT); after a failed grasp the exit never starts by itself.

  15. 4 Exit To Push (starts by itself).
    At DONE push the lamp turns purple and the exit starts by itself 1 s later: the claw's reference is released first, then the gripper opens; when it reports open, the claw climbs 0.20 m and the arm folds home. To go sooner press 4 Exit To Push; to stop it press ABORT.
    • If the lamp says the gripper did not report OPEN, or push_pull/release was not available, nothing climbs: check the jaws, then press 4 Exit To Push again, or ABORT.

  16. 5 Go To Land Start.
    One transition back to Land Start, 1.3 m above the start mark, clear of the table, turning clockwise to −360° (about 24 s).
  17. 6 Land.
    Straight down from Land Start (1.3 m) to the 0.3 m hover above the start mark, (−0.60, 0) m: the vehicle lands where it took off. The status reads COMPLETE.
  18. Touch down.
    Back to SAFETY, land and disarm from the drone GS.

Hint: ABORT (red) works at any time: the gripper opens and contact ends; with the claw on the box the drone holds where it is for 1.5 s, backs 3 cm off against the push, then climbs 0.30 m with the arm folding home. Afterwards press 5 Go To Land Start and 6 Land; never land in place beside the table. The planner aborts by itself if the tilt stays above 10°, the force on the claw stays above 5 N (from the grasp to the exit), the box falls behind or runs ahead of its plan by more than 40 mm, the box tilts more than 2°, the box's mocap goes silent or freezes, the arm's joint states go silent, or q3 drops below 10°. A guard trip names itself in the status line. If DIRECT is lost with the claw on the box (watchdog, pilot STAB), the arm GS opens the gripper at once and the arm folds home 2 s later. If the box was moved before Ready (the downwash, a bump), press Get and Plan again, then Go To Start.
